author: Michael Caine
text: If theatre acting is an operation with a scalpel, movie acting is an operation with a laser.

author: Michael Caine, on the camera
text: It's watching you. It's your friend. Remember, it loves you.

author: Gloria Swanson, Sunset Blvd.
text: All right, Mr. DeMille, I'm ready for my close-up.

author: Charlie Chaplin
text: Life is a tragedy when seen in close-up, but a comedy in long-shot.

author: Ingmar Bergman
text: With a camera you can go into the stomach of a kangaroo. But to look at the human face, I think, is the most fascinating.

author: Orson Welles
text: A film is never really good unless the camera is an eye in the head of a poet.

author: Spencer Tracy, to Katharine Houghton
text: Know your lines and don't bump into the furniture.

author: Jean-Luc Godard, Le Petit Soldat
text: Photography is truth and the cinema is truth 24 times a second.
